messages:
alex_m: Quick pulse — need a social sequence for Apr 12 webinar 'Inference Economics: benchmarks & tradeoffs'. Goal: X thread + LinkedIn long post + 2 follow-ups. Also need UTMs and lead routing to SDR queue. Can we finalize drafts by EOB tomorrow?

sara_ops: Got it. CTA = webinar sign-up primarily? Want separate CTAs per channel? Also confirm timezone for scheduled posts.

jordan_g: Primary CTA: webinar sign-up. Secondary: gated benchmark report (post-webinar). For routing: signups with company email -> SDR queue 'Bench-Webinar'. Others -> nurture. Use utm_campaign=bench-apr12.

priya_content: I'll spin up: 1) X thread (6 cards), 2) LinkedIn long post, 3) two follow-up short posts. Need hero stat + 3 soundbites. Miguel — can you share hero graphic?

miguel_design: On it. I'll upload hero stat PNG + 3 carousel frames by 10am tomorrow. Will include export variants (1200x675 for X, 1200x628 for LinkedIn).

sara_ops: Scheduler-bot: can you propose slots so I can load into Buffer/HubSpot? Also confirm we want to tag partners in the day-of thread.

scheduler-bot: Available slots for Apr 12: 2024-04-12T09:30:00-07:00 (live intro), 2024-04-12T12:00:00-07:00 (reminder), 2024-04-13T10:00:00-07:00 (post + report CTA). Reply with slot IDs to lock.

jordan_g: Routing/CRM: Add leads to SFDC campaign 'BenchApr12'. Use lead source = social_bench and utm_source={platform}. High-intent criteria = company email + job title not generic. I'll send exact SFDC flow after lunch.

priya_content: Draft X thread (paste sample below). Please critique tone + length. Also note: use short link to signup with UTM.

priya_content: ```
1/ We measured latency & per-token cost across open models — the results surprised us.
2/ Short summary: 3 models, 2 regions, 4 latency buckets.
3/ Key stat: 2x cost variance at 95th pctl under small batches.
4/ Join our webinar Apr 12 to see the full benchmark + playbooks: https://redwood.ai/bench?utm_campaign=bench-apr12&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social
5/ We'll drop the full report after the session. RSVP -> brief live demo + Q&A.
6/ TL;DR: Serving choices change unit economics more than model choice in many cases.
```

alex_m: Nice. Keep the CTAs consistent across channels, and make sure we surface the hero stat in the first card.

miguel_design: Uploaded hero_v2.png to the assets channel: <link to asset>. Alt text: 'Latency vs cost tradeoff across models'. Format: PNG, SVG.

sara_ops: I've created a working spreadsheet for the posting cadence + UTMs. Can people review? CSV snippet below. If approved, I'll push to Buffer and include tracking.

sara_ops: ```
post_time,platform,copy,asset,utm_campaign,utm_source,sd_queue
2024-04-12T09:30:00-07:00,x,"Thread start: short stat + link",hero_v2.png,bench-apr12,x,Bench-Webinar
2024-04-12T12:00:00-07:00,linkedin,"Long post w/ 2 bullets + signup link",carousel_1.png,bench-apr12,linkedin,Nurture
2024-04-13T10:00:00-07:00,x,"Post + report CTA",carousel_2.png,bench-apr12,x,Bench-Webinar
```

jordan_g: Approve UTMs. For HubSpot/SFDC mapping: use utm_medium=social, utm_source={platform}, utm_campaign=bench-apr12, and add hidden field lead_intent set by the form.

priya_content: Quick ask: can we shorten the LinkedIn intro so it fits 3 bite-sized paragraphs? Sharing a 1-paragraph draft in 30m.

alex_m: Sounds good. Approve schedule slots above. Sara — please push to queue once Miguel's assets are in. I'll handle partner mentions for the day-of thread. :thumbsup:

sara_ops: Will do. I'll also add tagging rules: partners = @openbench, @bench-partner.

priya_content: Uploaded draft copy in the doc. Requesting quick reviews from Jordan + Alex before EOB tomorrow.

jordan_g: Quick note — include a UTM for paid boost test in one of the posts (small budget) to measure conversion lift. Use utm_content=boost-testA.

alex_m: Good call. Let's keep one boosted post (day-of reminder). Budget details in the ad channel.

sara_ops: Locking tasks: Miguel -> design by 10am tomorrow; Priya -> final drafts by 5pm tomorrow; Jordan -> CRM mapping by EOB today; Alex -> partner mentions and approval. I'll push scheduled posts after assets + final copy.

scheduler-bot: Slot IDs: 42 (Apr12 09:30), 43 (Apr12 12:00), 44 (Apr13 10:00). Reply with "lock 42,43,44" to reserve.

alex_m: lock 42,43,44

sara_ops: Great — thanks team. I'll post the final schedule and add tracking docs in the campaign folder.

priya_content: Thanks — will ping when drafts are ready.

alex_m: Thanks all.
